hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$(python3 tools/review_ledger_guard.py check --staged 2>&1) || { echo "ADRL review ledger guard rejected the staged commit. Do not bypass; fix the record or append a new one." >&2; echo "$out" | tail -8 >&2; exit 2; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python3 tools/review_ledger_guard.py blockers 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
b=[x.get("global_id") for x in d.get("blocking_findings",[])]
msg=("ADRL review blockers outstanding: %d (%s). Legacy reviews unknown to this query: %d." % (len(b), ", ".join(b), len(d.get("legacy_unknown",[])))) if b else "ADRL review ledger: no structured blockers outstanding."
print(json.dumps({"systemMessage": msg}))'
